_about: Townsfolk, two adventurers and two man-shaped monsters redrawn so they can be rigged and animated (decision 0016): arms clear of the body, close-fitting clothes, nothing held. Same route as the player's body (decision 0015).

subjects.subject: A warm middle-aged village innkeeper, a stout man with rolled sleeves, a short patched apron tied tight at the waist over trousers, kind smile, short hair, earthy clothes in cream, tan and leaf green. Close-fitting clothes. No cloak, no cape, no backpack, no bag, nothing held in the hands, no loose hanging cloth, arms bare or in tight sleeves and well clear of the body.
